settings.title: AI settings

enabled.label: AI features
enabled.desc: The master switch. Turned off, no AI feature runs for anyone - members or background jobs.

monthly_budget.label: Monthly site budget
monthly_budget.desc: The most the whole site may spend on AI in a month. When it runs out, every AI feature pauses until the next month.

system_budget.label: Background jobs budget
system_budget.desc: A separate cap for automation such as ALT text, inside the site budget.

default_points.label: Default monthly points
default_points.desc: What a member gets each month unless their role says otherwise. One point is worth {usd}.

requests_per_minute.label: Requests per minute
requests_per_minute.desc: How often one member may start an AI feature.

user_concurrency.label: Parallel runs per member
user_concurrency.desc: How many AI features one member may have running at once.

system_concurrency.label: Parallel background runs
system_concurrency.desc: How many background AI jobs may run at once across the site.

retention.label: Keep history for
retention.desc: Older operation records are deleted. Prompts and outputs are never stored either way.

enabled.label: Write ALT text automatically
enabled.desc: Describe uploaded images in the background. Needs a monthly site budget, so it can never spend without a cap.

alt.needs_budget: Set a monthly site budget before turning on automatic ALT text.

batch_size.label: Images queued per sweep
batch_size.desc: How many images missing ALT text one hourly sweep queues. The worker then describes them two at a time, every minute.
